g.text: Source topology on develop · 14 November 2026 · Hosting configuration, not a live deployment inventory
Database CA mounted into API, worker and setup jobs
One demo worker node by default; app replicas are configurable.
Readiness/liveness probes; per-pod CPU and memory budgets.
03 MANAGED POSTGRESQL + PGVECTOR / outside Kubernetes · private VPC + database firewall
One database holds application state, the durable queue, catalog facts and vectors. TLS: verify-full.
Product and recipe imports are separate
READING KEY Blue: application boundaries Green: data / entry points Purple: external AI Gold: supplier / operations
Hosted search and recipe planning need explicit activation. All accepted orders are mocks; no stock reservation.
